_comment: Imagineering ground truth fixtures. Each record matches ImagineeredSample: photo_path (str, relative to repo root), room_type (RoomType str value), style_prompt (str), reference_features (list of str the output should visibly exhibit). No single correct output image exists — evaluators use LLM-as-judge and feature-retention metrics.

style_prompt: Reimagine this kitchen in a warm Japandi style: natural oak cabinets, matte black hardware, open shelving with ceramics, soft neutral walls, and abundant natural light. Keep the original room layout intact.

Reimagine this kitchen in a clean Scandinavian minimal style: white flat-front cabinets, light birch accents, integrated appliances hidden behind seamless panels, white subway tile splashback, and large windows flooding the space with cool daylight. Keep the original room layout intact.

Reimagine this kitchen in an industrial loft style: exposed concrete or brick walls, open metal shelving, matte black faucets and handles, stainless steel countertops, and Edison bulb pendant lighting overhead. Keep the original room layout intact.

Reimagine this kitchen in a cosy farmhouse style: shaker-panel cabinets in sage green, a large white ceramic farmhouse sink, warm wooden open shelving, terracotta floor tiles, and a vintage-inspired range cooker as the focal point. Keep the original room layout intact.
